items.title: DONE merge 前排除 runtime activity log 变更
items.context: story_advance DONE auto-git commit 前，将 .koala/activity.jsonl 和 docs/story/activity.jsonl 都对齐 main 或从 index 中移除，确保 story 分支 merge 不因 runtime log 冲突。

happy.desc: main 和 story 分支都修改 .koala/activity.jsonl 时，DONE 语义提交会先把该 runtime log 对齐 main，最终 merge 不产生 activity conflict

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/checklist-json-done-log-dirty.json:146 WHY reproduces main/story .koala activity divergence and verifies merge keeps main activity without conflict severity:high

edge.desc: main 不存在 activity log 但 story 分支存在 tracked .koala/activity.jsonl 时，DONE cleanup 会从 index 移除 runtime log，不把它带进 main

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/checklist-json-done-log-dirty.json:161 WHY covers story-only tracked runtime activity removal from the index severity:high

adversarial.desc: 同一次 DONE 里真实源码文件存在冲突时，runtime log cleanup 不应隐藏源码冲突

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/checklist-json-done-log-dirty.json:177 WHY proves real src/app.ts conflicts still surface after activity cleanup severity:high
